name: Nemesis
source: The year is 2099. Humanoid monsters known as Nemesis are appearing around the world, kidnapping girls who are never seen again. Riley, a newly recruited secret agent, takes on the mission of discovering where these Nemesis came from and putting an end to them alongside his superior, Emily.
